issues.display_title: Issue #1915: fix(editor): floor hover pointer donut not showing in Fjord room in editor mode
issues.main_description_html:
Description

In the Fjord exhibition gallery, hovering over the floor in Preview mode shows the navigation reticle/donut pointer as expected. However, in Editor mode, hovering over the floor does not show the donut pointer.

Root Cause Analysis

  1. Preview Mode:
    • Uses _setPointerEffectTransparency(), which tests ray intersection directly against this.donutAreaMeshes. The visual floor mesh is ignored, so the pointer displays properly.
  2. Editor Mode:
    • Uses _displayPointerOnDonutArea(), which calls this.scene.multiPickWithRay(ray) and only evaluates hits[0].
    • In Fjord, the visual floor mesh sits coplanar or slightly in front of donut_area. Because hits[0] is named floor (not donut_area or stairs), the check fails and flags pointerIntesectWithWall = true.

Proposed Solution

In src/app/pages/virtual-gallery/editor/editor.service.ts (_displayPointerOnDonutArea):

  • If hits[0] is a floor mesh, inspect whether a donut_area or stairs mesh is present at the same depth tolerance (Math.abs(h.distance - hits[0].distance) <= 0.1).
  • If matched, render pointerEffect(donutHit).
  • If blocked by walls/objects or outside donut_area, keep pointerIntesectWithWall = true.

Affected Files

Overview

Optimize Lighthouse audit scores across Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO for public-facing routes (Homepage, Pricing, Catalogue, Blog, etc.) to enhance user experience, search discoverability, and Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, and TBT).

Background & Problems

  1. Initial Load & Core Web Vitals:
    • Initial JavaScript bundle size and render-blocking stylesheets increase First Contentful Paint (FCP) and Largest Contentful Paint (LCP).
    • Third-party tracking and analytics scripts (such as Countly, Google tags) execute during initial page load rather than deferring until idle time.
    • Heavy hero assets and dynamic elements can cause layout thrashing and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
  2. Accessibility:
    • Minor heading hierarchy mismatches and missing accessible names on icon buttons lower the accessibility audit score.
  3. Best Practices:
    • Deprecated attributes or unoptimized image dimensions without explicit aspect ratios impact the Best Practices category.
  4. SEO & Crawlability:
    • Opportunities exist to refine meta tag structures and link texts to achieve a consistent 100 SEO score across all public routes.

Scope of Improvements

  1. Critical Rendering Path & Asset Optimization:
    • Defer non-critical stylesheets and heavy third-party tracking scripts to run after initial paint / during idle time.
    • Implement font stability and font-display: swap to prevent layout shifts and FOIT (Flash of Invisible Text).
    • Lazy-load below-the-fold widgets, modals, and embedded media.
  2. Accessibility Compliance:
    • Standardize heading structures across page sections.
    • Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) contain valid and unique accessible names (aria-label).
  3. Best Practices & Layout Stability:
    • Define explicit dimensions/aspect ratios on images and video placeholders to achieve zero CLS.
    • Resolve console deprecation warnings and modernize legacy web APIs.
  4. Audit Target:

issues.display_title: Issue #1901: feat(support): Virtual Galleries Management with Backend API Integration and Editor Access
issues.main_description_html:
References

  • PRD: #1894 ([PRD] Villume Virtual Galleries Management)
  • Backend API: GoThruMedia/villume-backend-go#213 (API Get Exhibitions (Published / Draft) with Restricted Access, Search, Filtering, and Sorting)
  • Design & UI: #1897 (Villume Virtual Galleries Management - branch design/villume-virtual-galleries-management)

Overview

Implement the Virtual Galleries Management page inside the Support area of Villume Admin. This provides Support operators with a centralized workspace to view, search, filter, and inspect user virtual galleries (both published and draft), quickly launch the virtual gallery editor in the owner's account context (impersonation), and view live public exhibitions.

Scope of Work

1. Navigation & Access Control

  • Support Dropdown & Mobile Menu:
    • Add Virtual Galleries menu item inside the Support dropdown popover (HeaderComponent) and mobile navigation drawer.
    • Highlight the Support section as active when visiting /support/virtual-galleries.
  • Routing & Guard:
    • Register route /support/virtual-galleries under app-features.routes.ts.
    • Protect route with authSupportGuard so it is accessible exclusively to authenticated Support users (user_type === 'support' or active support session).

2. Backend API Integration (VirtualGalleriesService)

  • Integrate directly with GET /v1/exhibitions/published endpoint from villume-backend-go#213.
  • Query Parameters:
    • page (default: 1): Current page number.
    • limit (default: 10, max: 100): Items per page.
    • status (default: all or published): all, published, draft.
    • search (optional): Case-insensitive search matching gallery name, owner email, or owner username.
    • sort (default: recent_published / recent_created):
      • recent_published
      • oldest_published
      • recent_created
      • oldest_created
      • name_a_z
      • name_z_a
  • Response Format: 
    {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "messages": "Get Exhibition success",
    "total": 42,
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 10,
    "totalPages": 5,
    "exhibitions": [
      {
        "id": "c1f7b8d4-6e11-4f9a-883a-44243a059d04",
        "user": {
          "id": "a2e8c9d0-1234-5678-90ab-cdef12345678",
          "username": "creator",
          "email": "creator@example.com",
          "first_name": "John",
          "last_name": "Doe",
          "avatar": null
        },
        "name": "Gallery Title",
        "thumbnail": "https://...",
        "published": true,
        "status": "published",
        "description": "Gallery description",
        "started": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        "share_string": "gallery-title-xyz",
        "ended": null,
        "unlimited_time": true,
        "countdown_timer": true,
        "cover_image": "https://...",
        "model_type": "default",
        "created_at": "2026-04-20T10:00:00Z",
        "published_date": "2026-04-21T00:00:00Z"
      }
    ]
  }
}

3. Search, Filtering, and Sorting

  • Search (Server-Side):
    • Input field with debounce (300-400ms) sending search parameter to API.
    • Search query synchronized with URL query params (?search=...).
  • Status Filter:
    • Filter options: All (?status=all), Published (?status=published), Draft (?status=draft).
    • Active counts displayed for each status tab.
  • Sorting:
    • Server-side sorting passing sort parameter:
      • recently_published -> recent_published
      • oldest_published -> oldest_published
      • recently_created -> recent_created
      • oldest_created -> oldest_created
      • name_asc -> name_a_z
      • name_desc -> name_z_a
  • View Modes:
    • Toggle between List View (Table) and Grid View (Cards).

4. Gallery Actions

  • View Editor (R9, R10, R11):
    • Triggers owner impersonation via POST /v1/auth/impersonate using user.email and user.username.
    • On success, stores support session token (SupportSessionService.saveSupportToken()), updates auth token via LayoutsService.updateToken(), and redirects directly to /editor/:id.
    • Fallback to direct navigation /editor/:id if impersonation is unavailable in dev/local mode.
  • View Gallery (R12, R13):
    • Opens public viewer in a new tab: ${environment.viewer_path}/${share_string}.
    • Active only for published galleries (published === true / status === 'published'); disabled or hidden for drafts.

5. UI States & Polish

  • Loading spinner / skeleton indicators during asynchronous data fetching.
  • Empty states (no galleries exist on platform).
  • No-results states when search/filter returns zero matches with a quick "Clear Filters" action.
  • Canonical pagination controls (page, limit, totalPages, total).
  • Responsive design across desktop, tablet, and mobile breakpoints.
  • Full dark / light mode support using existing Villume design tokens.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Support users can navigate to Virtual Galleries from the Support header dropdown and mobile drawer.
  • Route /support/virtual-galleries is protected by authSupportGuard.
  • Exhibitions are retrieved via GET /v1/exhibitions/published using server-side pagination (page, limit).
  • Search query is passed to backend (?search=...) and filters by gallery name, owner email, and username.
  • Status filter (?status=all|published|draft) retrieves corresponding published and draft galleries.
  • All 6 sorting modes send correct sort parameter to backend and reorder results.
  • Each gallery displays thumbnail, name, owner email/avatar, created date, published date, and status.
  • "View Editor" action logs in as owner and navigates directly to /editor/:id.
  • "View Gallery" action is available only for published galleries and opens ${environment.viewer_path}/:share_string in a new tab.
  • Clear loading, empty, and no-results states are presented.
  • Clean branch without SSO code so it can merge into master and development.
  • All unit tests pass and development build compiles cleanly.
